description: The capabilities the main window is granted. Every entry is here because a feature needs it. Shell execution is deliberately absent: a step is started by the host's own typed command, from a program path and an argument vector, never by a shell plugin handed a string. The dialog plugin may only open and save — it returns a path the person chose, and the host's own command reads or writes that one file; there is no filesystem plugin, so nothing can walk a directory.
